correctness.rationale: All monic integral divisor degrees are totient subset sums; the 2-power cyclotomic weight blocks fill [0,M]. For p−1>M, first compare mod p−1, then sequentially mod p to prove tuple uniqueness; place-value dominance supplies order and exact gaps. Counts sum to (M+1)^(b+1)−1, endpoints 0,N. Coupled uniform digits prove distributional convergence; separated IFS cylinders and mass distribution prove exact Hausdorff dimension and singular non-atomic measure. Independent totient bitset enumeration checked 77 triples, without claiming to prove the infinite case.

value.rationale: The established binary yes/no phi-practical classification leaves the arithmetic shape of missing degrees in the noncomplete two-prime family undescribed. An exhaustive multiscale gap census, exact omitted-degree count at arbitrary exponents, and a singular Cantor limiting degree distribution form a motivated structural quantification of incompleteness for a canonical cyclotomic family. The proof does not require external conjectures.
